business_scope.primary_industry_name: Chartering and Operation of Offshore Platform Support Ships

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Panama (central unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state corporate registry or tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified commercial and corporate framework) with substantial Common Law influence in maritime, admiralty, banking and international finance practice
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA, in force 2012) with investment chapter, complementing the Panama–US Bilateral Investment Treaty (1982, in force 1991)
Wider network of 25+ Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) with OECD and EU jurisdictions under the Global Forum on Transparency and Exchange of Information

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT framework) as amended by Ley 98 de 17 de diciembre de 2021; Decreto Ejecutivo 363 de 2015 (UAF implementing regulations); Ley 254 de 24 de noviembre de 2021 (Beneficial Ownership Registry - Registro de Beneficiarios Finales) and Resolución DGI 100-2021; Ley 32 de 1927 (General Corporation Law for Sociedad Anónima); Ley 52 de 2016 (special-purpose LLC) as comparative reference; Resoluciones of the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) governing customer due diligence and suspicious transaction reporting.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney (Poder General de Representación) granted by each proposed shareholder to the resident Panamanian incorporation attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Panama is a contracting party to the Hague Apostille Convention, in force 15 March 1991); documents originating from non-Convention jurisdictions require consular legalization at the competent Panamanian Embassy or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified notarized copy of the valid passport or national identity document of each ultimate beneficial owner, director and officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing / civil registry authority of the individual's country of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in country of origin followed by Hague Apostille or consular legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and economic source-of-funds statement covering the corporate purpose of offshore supply vessel chartering and leasing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Regulated commercial bank or licensed financial institution maintaining the shareholder's account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path for certified reference letters; otherwise consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and Registry Extract for any corporate shareholder, including authenticated ownership chain documentation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicable foreign companies registry or corporate registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Panamanian consular legalization as applicable

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory multi-list screening of every shareholder, director, officer, registered agent and ultimate beneficial owner before incorporation: (i) Panamanian PEP classification under Ley 23 de 2015 (public officials, legislators, judges, high-ranking military, and directors of state-owned enterprises), (ii) OFAC SDN List, (iii) UN Consolidated Sanctions List, (iv) EU and UK sanctions and financial-restriction lists, and (v) domestic UAF and DGI alert indices. Verification must include source of funds, source of wealth, beneficial-ownership chain, and adverse-media checks. The maritime charter scope ISIC 5222 with 'Medium_Risk_Enhanced' classification imposes enhanced due diligence, including confirmation of the charterer's identity, vessel activity, and absence of sanctions exposure in the vessel traffic or payment flow (Swift Wire and Escrow Maritime rails).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá - Sección Mercantil (online name reservation and consultation platforms at www.registropublico.gob.pa, including the PANATRAMITA governmental services portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names may be registered in any language using Latin alphabet characters (A-Z); non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into Latin characters with a Spanish transliteration or official certification. The name must be typographically legible, not identical or confusingly similar to any existing name in the Mercantil database, and must contain the mandated corporate identifier suffix (e.g., 'S.A.', 'Sociedad Anónima', 'Inc.', or 'Corp.') in accordance with Ley 32 de 1927.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco, Banking, Bancario (requires Superintendencia de Bancos prior license)
Seguros, Reaseguros, Aseguradora (requires Superintendencia de Seguros authorization)
Valores, Broker, Casa de Valores, Exchange (requires Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores authorization)
Ministerio, Gobierno, Presidencia, Estado, República (state-sovereignty tokens prohibited absent express ministerial authorization)
Canal de Panamá, Panama Canal Authority (exclusive sovereign and concession terms)
Ltd., LLP, GmbH, BV or other foreign entity-type suffixes inconsistent with the Panamanian S.A. form
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The applicant's licensed resident attorney files the name reservation electronically at the Registro Público de Panamá. A rejection notice cites the conflicting registry entry or prohibited token. The attorney must submit a written reconsideración (reconsideration) to the Director General of the Public Registry within five business days of notification, referencing the reservation request number and the amended proposed name. If the rejection is based on confusing similarity, the applicant may either (i) obtain a written non-conflict release from the registered holder of the similar name, or (ii) file a reposición (administrative appeal) within three business days. A single 30-day extension of an approved reservation is available upon renewal payment; upon exhaustion, a fresh name reservation filing is required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for the statutory registered office. Panama mandates a physical registered office in the Republic of Panama, typically at the office of the licensed resident legal agent under Ley 32 de 1927. A purely virtual or mail-forwarding address cannot satisfy the statutory sede requirement. A supplementary commercial or booking address may be virtual, but the statutory registered office must be a real, accessible address capable of receiving service of process and regulatory notifications.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Medium-high: approximately 35% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 24 months of operation for a 'Medium_Risk_Enhanced' offshore supply vessel chartering entity; probability increases to roughly 50% if the UAF, DGI, or the Public Registry initiates an AML/CFT or tax-residence structured inquiry involving USD wire flows or non-resident beneficial owners.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate name search and reservation (processing of up to three alternative names) - Registro Público de Panamá
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official registry arancel (statutory tariff) for name reservation and electronic filing surcharge

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of Articles of Incorporation (Escritura Pública de Constitución) in Panama City
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary of the Circuit of Panama / Notarial tariff schedule
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial fee scale for first-copy deeds plus paper and fiscal stamp costs (prevailing range USD 75-200)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of the Sociedad Anónima at the Public Registry Mercantil Section
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry inscription tariff based on the authorized capital bracket (standard USD 10,000 par value structure)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Power of Attorney (Poder General) notarization, apostille handling and courier for foreign shareholders
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Panamanian Notary and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Apostille Unit)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial fee plus Panamanian apostille certificate fee of USD 30-50 per document plus courier and translation coordination costs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered Agent (Residente Legal) - first year professional fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Panamanian law firm / registered agent service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark among premium maritime corporate service providers (USD 600-900 per year)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Statutory Registered Office (Sede Legal) at the registered agent's physical address - first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Panamanian law firm / registered agent service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate for statutory sede address and physical office infrastructure, bundled or separately invoiced by the agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial Ownership Registry initial declaration (Ley 254 de 2021, Resolución DGI 100-2021) including first-year filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) - Ministry of Economy and Finance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory UBO registry filing fee where applicable, plus the resident agent's compliance processing charge (Law 254 / DGI implementing resolutions)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed compliance provider / resident agent under Ley 23 de 2015
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per client onboarding file for a medium-risk enhanced maritime charter profile

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate legal advisory fee - drafting Articles of Incorporation, by-laws and ancillary statutory governance documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Panamanian attorney / corporate law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for full S.A. incorporation legal services (standard range USD 800-1,500)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 1927 (General Corporation Law of Panama), as amended; Articles 1, 4, 10 to 12, 28 to 30, 56, and 59, supplemented by the Panama Civil Code and relevant Executive Decrees on the Public Registry and maritime corporations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Dirección General del Registro Público, Sección de Personas Jurídicas
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public deed of incorporation (Escritura Pública de Constitución) containing the Articles of Incorporation (Pacto Social y Estatutos), filed with the Public Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital is required under Law 32 of 1927. Initial issued capital is set in the articles, commonly 100 registered no-par or par-value shares. No escrow account or pays-in deposit is legally required for a non-listed Sociedad Anónima.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: 1. Share Subscription: that the share subscription list presented at formation is approved; each initial subscriber accepts the number of paid-in shares stated opposite their name, and the subscribed share capital is declared fully issued and fully paid or subject to lawful contribution. 2. Registered Office: that the registered office of the Corporation shall be established at the address stated on the notarized foundation deed, and the corporate registered agent is appointed. 3. Officers: that the holders named in the minutes are appointed President and Secretary-Treasurer, each to hold office until the first general shareholders meeting or successor appointment, and are expressly authorized to sign charter agreements, open bank accounts, secure vessel registrations, and apply for operational licenses.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Dirección de Nombres, online via www.registropublico.gob.pa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed corporate name through the Public Registry online name-search module. Verify that the chosen name is distinctive and not confusingly similar to an existing registered entity. Upon clearance, reserve the corporate name for the statutory reservation period to protect priority of incorporation.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name and at least two alternate names
Description of the corporate purpose
Copy of the passport or official ID of the applicant or formation agent
Signed name-search request letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused or deemed confusingly similar, file an alternate reserved name or add a distinctive numerical or geographical element. One free resubmission is available within the name reservation period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public in Panama, under the supervision of the Supreme Court of Justice of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Pacto Social y Estatutos for a Sociedad Anónima in Spanish. The incorporators and initial shareholders must execute the public deed before a licensed Panamanian notary. The deed must include share capital, registered agent acceptance, director appointments, and the corporate object covering offshore vessel leasing and chartering.
required_dossiers: Articles of incorporation and bylaws (draft)
Name clearance certificate from the Public Registry
Certified identification documents of shareholders and directors
Registered agent acceptance letter
Due diligence and beneficial ownership declarations required by Law 23 of 2015
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies a defect, inconsistency, or missing clause, prepare a corrective deed before the same notary and re-execute the instrument without affecting the priority date of the original name reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the Public Deed at the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Personas Jurídicas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the original and one duplicate of the notarized public deed to the Public Registry. Pay the corresponding stamp taxes and registration fees. The Registry reviews the instrument for legal compliance, issues the corporate registration certificate, and assigns the company business identifier used for tax and commercial purposes.
required_dossiers: Original notarized public deed of incorporation
Duplicate certified copy for the Registry
Registry filing fee payment receipt
Authorization letter if filing through a registered agent or attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a prevention or query, respond within the statutory period with corrected documentation. Structural defects require an amendment deed (Escritura de Subsanación). After cure, the Registry stamps the final certificate of inscription.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gaceta Oficial de la República de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish the legally required excerpt of the corporate inscription in the official gazette. Obtain the publication certificate and attach it to the company statutory records. This step completes formal notice to third parties of the company's existence and principal officers.
required_dossiers: Registry-certified copy of the inscription
Cover letter requesting publication
Publication fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication is delayed or contains typographical errors, request de oficio a corrected publication through a fe de erratas. The valid text is the one validated by the Public Registry, not the uncorrected gazette excerpt.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Municipal Operating Notice, and Commercial Licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministry of Economy and Finance; Municipality of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company with DGI to obtain the taxpayer identification number (RUC). Complete the fiscal domicile registration and any required online forms. File the municipal Aviso de Operación and obtain the local commercial license. If the vessel leasing operation is to begin immediately, submit the maritime operating license application with the Panama Maritime Authority.
required_dossiers: Certificate of corporate registration from the Public Registry
Published gazette certificate
Registered agent appointment certificate
DGI RUC application and taxpayer data form
Municipal business license application and physical address documentation
Beneficial ownership registry filing confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI or the municipal authority queries the application, correct the inconsistency in corporate name, address, or activity description and resubmit. Any minor late-payment penalty should be settled within five business days to avoid encumbrance of the company registration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Autoridad Marítima de Panamá (AMP) – Dirección General de Marina Mercante
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Operación como Empresa Arrendadora de Buques de Apoyo Offshore / Vessel Operator and Leasing License for Offshore Supply Vessel Chartering under Law 55 of 2008, as amended

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente de Panamá (MiAMBIENTE) – Dirección de Verificación del Desempeño Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III (Environmental Registration and Environmental Management Plan) for existing vessel leasing operations; Category II (Semidetailed Environmental Impact Assessment) is required if shore-based ports, terminal facilities, or fuel storage installations are constructed.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with MARPOL 73/78 Annexes I to VI; oily-water discharges limited to 15 ppm using approved oily-water separators; no untreated sewage or garbage discharge within Panamanian or international regulated waters; VOC emissions controlled under MARPOL Annex VI; all waste transfers required to use MiAMBIENTE-authorized waste management operators.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá; structural load inspection for shore offices, vessel-support facilities, and mooring infrastructure; workplace health and safety clearance from the Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL) and the Dirección General de Salud Ocupacional of the Ministerio de Salud (MINSA).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF) - tax e-portal: SIME (Sistema Integrado de Mecanización Electrónica) at https://sime.mef.gob.pa; institutional site: https://www.dgi.mef.gob.pa. Corporate registry: Registro Público de Panamá. Maritime licensing and flag registration: Autoridad Marítima de Panamá (AMP).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama has no central bank in a monetary-authority sense. The U.S. dollar is legal tender and the Panamanian balboa circulates only as divisional coins at a 1:1 fixed rate. The fiscal agent for the Republic is Banco Nacional de Panamá (BNP), while the prudential regulation of banks, foreign exchange clearing, and AML/CFT enforcement is vested in the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP). The Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF) retains sovereign reserve and external debt policy functions. For practical FX control purposes, the SBP and BNP constitute the reference authorities for dollarized clearing and cross-border banking compliance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama operates an unrestricted dual-currency system in which both the U.S. dollar and the balboa are freely convertible in the current account and the capital account without central bank prior approval, exchange controls, surrender requirements, or settlement delays. Profit remittances, dividend distributions, capital repatriation, and offshore debt-service payments may be transferred freely through the banking system. The only material constraint is territorial taxation: dividends paid out of Panamanian-source taxable income attract a 10% dividend withholding tax (5% on bearer shares where still permitted, now immobilized); dividends consisting purely of extraterritorial charter hire are outside the Panamanian income-tax net provided the vessel-leasing activity is executed, delivered, and performed outside Panamanian territory and no Panamanian-source activity is interposed.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender or conversion obligation exists. Panama does not impose a mandatory timeline, minimum conversion ratio, or export-proceeds repatriation requirement. Charter hire and operating revenues received in USD are immediately lawful domestic currency; receipts denominated in EUR, GBP, or other foreign currencies may be retained in foreign-currency accounts and converted at freely negotiated interbank rates without central bank filing or declaration. For territorial tax substantiation, the company should retain charter-parties, invoices, inward remittance advice, and bank statements demonstrating that the proceeds are booked outside Panama but repatriated to a Panamanian operating account.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operacional USD treasury account with daily sweep and cash management
Capital escrow account for shareholder capital injection and creditor collection
Maritime charter-hire escrow and collection account for offshore supply vessel operations
Institutional operational account linked to Panama-flagged vessel registry transactions
Corporate current account with FX and derivative market access

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium with serious legal restrictions. Panama does not maintain a dedicated electronic money institution (EMI) licensing class. Foreign digital EMIs may not take deposits or issue payment instruments in Panama without an SBP banking license, and unlicensed cross-border EMIs are generally refused onboarding by local compliance departments. In practice, an offshore vessel chartering treasury can use an EMI only as a payments distribution layer through a sponsored settlement account held at an SBP-licensed bank, with all funds passing through the local bank's nostro chain. Legal constraints arise under Law 42 of 2001 on Anti-Money Laundering, which requires all fund-transfer service providers to be supervised by the SBP or to clear exclusively through an SBP-licensed bank. Consequently, the resilient blueprint is a bank-provided virtual account / API cash-management gateway rather than a standalone foreign EMI relationship.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandated for this onboarding class. Under SBP due-diligence rules (SBP Resolution 008-2016 and the consolidated AML/CFT guidelines), the bank's compliance officer must visually identify at least one signatory director or a duly authorized attorney-in-fact who presents an original general power of attorney (Carta Poder) and a certified copy of the company's constitutional documents. Enhanced due diligence for ISIC 5222, rated Medium Risk Enhanced, requires an in-person interview at the bank's branch with two compliance officers; remote video opening is available only for one-director, non-maritime, low-risk structures and is not accepted for offshore supply vessel charters. A licensed Panamanian attorney may act as an attestor-introducer, but the director and ultimate beneficial owner must still provide passport, utility bill, professional or business reference, and a 12-month source-of-funds statement within the bank's document validity window.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bearer share or immobilized bearer-share history in the Sociedad Anónima capital structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the amended by-laws demonstrating complete suspension of bearer-share issuance; notarized shares and transfers ledger (Libro de Acciones y Transferencias) evidencing immobilization of all shares at the correspondent bank or an authorized custody agent; certificate of good standing issued by the Registro Público de Panamá; and the fully filed declaration in the Panama Final Beneficiary Registry (UBO Regulation) confirming the natural-person owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of economic substance in the extraterritorial vessel leasing activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete charter-party agreements (Barecon 89 or Supplytime 2017), hire invoices and receipts, Panamanian-flag vessel registration certificate, IMO number and tonnage certificate, AIS position and voyage data, crew payroll and manning records, and a current offshore platform supply operating license or authorization evidencing genuine commercial activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Undisclosed nominee shareholder or tax-transparent trust presentation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sworn nominee disclosure letter, original trust deed or certificate of trust, identity of settlor and protector, sworn declaration of the economic beneficiary, and independent background-screening reports (World-Check, Dow Jones, or equivalent) completed by the bank at the UBO level.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds and source of wealth insufficiently documented for capital injections above USD 500,000
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 12-month originating-bank statements, prior vessel sale and ship disposition documents, audited financial statements or tax returns of the contributor, trust/will/inheritance distribution instruments, and a notarized declaration of origin of funds executed before a Panama-licensed attorney integrating the complete paper trail.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions exposure in voyage pattern or counterparty chartering within high-risk jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions screening of every charter-party counterparty and associated vessel, explicit charter clause excluding OFAC/EU/UN sanctioned waters and cargoes, up-to-date P&I club and hull insurance certificates, AIS tracking proving sanctioned-port non-approach, and a sanctions legal memorandum certified by a Panama-licensed counsel.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant rail: SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfer for equity injections, with the shareholder's originating bank crediting the Panamanian beneficiary bank's U.S. correspondent account (for instance JP Morgan Chase, Citibank, or Bank of New York Mellon) through Fedwire, followed by the Panamanian bank's internal ledger transfer to the Sociedad Anónima's operating account. For amounts above USD 1,000,000, MT202 COV is used. Purpose designation: category PROV with narrative in field 72 citing ISIC 5222 offshore supply vessel leasing, reference to the chartering agreement and board resolution authorizing capital increase. Verification required by the receiving bank: notarized board resolution, updated shareholders ledger, certificate of good standing, and a source-of-funds portfolio for the contributing shareholder. No central bank declaration is required for inbound capital, but FATCA and CRS reporting is automatic.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rails for trade settlements: (i) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for bunker payments, spares, crew payroll, and offshore facility charges; (ii) commercial letters of credit opened at the Panamanian bank or its U.S. correspondent in favor of shipyards and equipment suppliers, funded by MT103 reimbursements under the L/C; and (iii) dedicated maritime escrow accounts at Towerbank or Banistmo for charter-hire collections and end-of-voyage net settlements. Each disbursement file must evidence charter-party reference, invoice number, and the vessel's port call or contract performance milestone. The treasury desk should run daily zero-balance sweeps from collection escrow into an interest-bearing USD investment account and maintain standby letters of credit for offshore operators and port agents.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/EUR and USD/GBP plain-vanilla FX forwards up to twelve months executed under an ISDA or bank master agreement
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing BRL, COP, MXN, and CLP for charter hire linked to Latin American offshore fields, settled in USD
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (USD/EUR, USD/GBP) matching charter receipts against disbursement currencies
FX call and put options on USD versus Latin American currencies permitted under SBP simple derivative authorization with bank-approved trading line
Intra-group centralized hedging via the Panamanian treasury pool with documented prohibition of speculative positions under Panama's Banking Law 47 of 2008 and SBP operational risk rules

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Impuesto de Anualidad) of the Sociedad Anónima
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas, Republic of Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, on or before 31 March; the DGI accepts deferred payment until 31 December with penalties
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A USD 50 late-payment penalty plus 1% monthly default interest applies; if the annual tax remains unpaid through 31 December, the Registro Público de Panamá may administratively dissolve and strike off the company, requiring full payment of accrued fees, penalties, and a legalization/reinstatement procedure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and Corporate Data Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent (Agente Residente), supervised by the Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros (SSNF)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March for the annual confirmation; any share transfer or change of beneficial ownership must additionally be reported to the registered agent within 15 working days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit the confirmation permits the registered agent to suspend services, file a suspicious transaction report with the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UIAF), and initiate a formal AML non-cooperation process; persistent default can elevate the entity's risk profile and lead to involuntary administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit applies to a non-reporting Panamanian S.A. under Law 32 of 1927. An independent audit becomes mandatory only if the S.A. is a licensed bank, insurance company, securities issuer or fund supervised by the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores, is designated by the DGI as a Gran Contribuyente (large taxpayer) requiring audited statements, or is required by the operating conditions of a Panama Maritime Authority license.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Panama (full IFRS for public-interest entities; IFRS for SMEs for private S.A.s), with DGI-prescribed local records for Panamanian tax purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each calendar year, the S.A. must answer the registered agent's annual due-diligence notice, reconfirm the current ultimate beneficial owner, certify that no uncaptured share transfers have occurred, and attach minutes of the annual shareholders' meeting. Any transfer of shares in the preceding fiscal year must already be reflected in the Register of Members; the registered agent retains the confirmation and updates the internal UBO ledger under Law 23 of 2015. No public filing with the Registro Público is required for share transfers unless the changes affect the registered directors or the corporate capital representation.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250 – USD 650 per annum for registered agent and registered office services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 – USD 4,500 per engagement when an audit is triggered by regulation or license condition

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation: Panamanian-source income only is taxed; foreign-source charter revenue is exempt. No general tax holiday for a standard S.A., but the Multinational Headquarters (SEM) regime applies a 0% rate to foreign-source income, and Panama-Pacifico entities enjoy a 100% corporate income tax exemption. Accelerated depreciation for vessel leasing assets, and a 5-year NOL carryforward are available to reduce effective Panamanian tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2300 (Declaración Anual de Impuesto Sobre la Renta) filed via the DGI e-Tax 2.0 online filing platform.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, with mandatory quarterly advance payments (Pagos Directos) on account.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 90 days after fiscal year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers, no later than 31 March of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from Panamanian-source charter operations, including vessel leasing fees, freight, and related services performed in Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident companies must report only revenue attributable to activities physically carried out in Panamanian territory; all foreign-source charter revenue must be excluded and disclosed separately in Box 1b.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from foreign-source activities and exempt Panamanian-source categories.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a schedule allocating charter revenue by country of performance. This amount is not taxed but is required to calculate the undistributed dividend WHT characterization.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Expenses, documented costs, depreciation, and NOL carryforwards directly attributable to producing Panamanian-source income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate expenses between Panamanian and foreign-source revenue using a consistent cost-accounting ratio. Exclude disallowed expenses and any charges attributable to foreign-source activities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income computed as Box 1a minus Box 2a, after applying the five-year NOL carryforward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only carry forward losses previously reported on Form 2300 and substantiated in Panama; losses from foreign-source operations are not deductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable at the 25% headline rate on net taxable income, reduced by advance payments made during the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reduce the gross tax by the quarterly Pagos Directos prepaid; do not claim foreign tax credits inside the Panamanian return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Withholding taxes undergone by the company and payments made by escrow agents or charterers on its behalf.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Support the credit with official DGI withholding certificates issued by the local payer; otherwise the credit is denied.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a monthly surcharge of 5% of the tax due, capped at 25%, plus default interest at 4% per month and a treasury charge. Non-filing incurs an administrative fine of B/. 500 to B/. 5,000; willful fraud is criminally punishable with imprisonment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a reduced DTA withholding rate, the beneficial owner must deliver to the Panamanian paying entity a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by its jurisdiction, together with Form 830 (Certificado de Residencia Fiscal) before the payment date. The withholding agent must retain the documentation, apply the reduced rate, and file the annual reconciliation with the DGI. Any excess withholding may be reclaimed via a refund petition under Article 60 of the Fiscal Code within three years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rates are 12.5% on royalties and 12.5% on interest sourced in Panama. Under Panama's DTA network, treaty rates are typically 5%–10% for royalties and 5%–10% for interest; interest paid to bona-fide foreign banks may be exempt at source when the debt financing is traceable to Panamanian operations.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: B/. 2,500,000 (Panamanian Balboa, pegged 1:1 to the US Dollar)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama applies Economic Substance Regulations under Law 254 of 2021, effective 1 January 2022. An offshore supply vessel lessor falls within the 'shipping' relevant activity and must maintain physical premises, employees, operational expenditure, and Board control in Panama proportional to the chartering business. The entity is required to file the annual economic substance return and keep documentary evidence; penalties for non-compliance range from B/. 5,000 to B/. 500,000 and may lead to cancellation of registration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting Panamanian-source vessel charter income from Form 2300, inflating deductions, or destroying accounting records to lower the taxable base.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of up to five times the evaded tax and imprisonment from 2 to 6 years under Panama's Fiscal Code and Criminal Code; the DGI may also close the commercial registry if the entity operates without true activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax and interest; criminal conviction triggers disqualification from office, travel bans, and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an offshore supply vessel charter platform with no employees, physical presence, business records, or Board decisions in Panama, using the S.A. solely to hold a vessel in a favourable registry.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR penalties for non-filing or false declaration range from B/. 10,000 to B/. 500,000; repeated failure to demonstrate substance results in disolución and removal from the companies registry.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be stripped of limited liability for unpaid corporate taxes under the veil-piercing doctrine, face personal seizure of assets, and be barred from acting as Panamanian directors for up to five years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving charter payments through Panamanian accounts derived from sanctioned persons or using the S.A. to launder proceeds without a formal underlying charter contract; failure to maintain the beneficial ownership register required by Law 254.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AML fines up to B/. 1,000,000 per infraction, forfeiture of vessels and bank accounts, and imprisonment of 5 to 12 years under Panama's AML legislation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are treated as gatekeepers; they face criminal prosecution, personal asset freezing, travel bans, and possible extradition to other sanction-enforcement jurisdictions.
